integrity: The proof starts from the source's exact PMF representation and its own asymptotic formula. The full open-access PDF was inspected at the model definition, asymptotic section, hazard limit, moment formulas, and simulation setting labeled heavy-tailed. A standalone checker independently compares direct PMF moments with corrected tail sums.
scientific_limitations: The finding corrects population moment formulas and asymptotic tail classification but does not determine how the source's numerical tables were computed.
Finite-range high kurtosis is compatible with an asymptotically light tail; the correction concerns asymptotic heavy-tail terminology.
The paper's inference, censoring, actuarial-risk, and goodness-of-fit results are not reassessed.
title: Correct tail-sum moments expose the EDBuE light-tail boundary
